app.title: Once: Cache CLI Commands
app.author: baquero
app.description: A Rust CLI utility that caches command outputs to speed up repetitive work.
proposed_tests: run `once echo hello` twice and verify the second run is served from cache
measure execution time difference between cached and uncached runs
test the `--clear` option to ensure cache is purged
